## Overview
### Introduction to xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent
The xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent model, released by X-ai on 2024-01-01, is a standard, non-open-source AI solution. This model is part of the x-ai/grok-4.20-multi-agent family and is designed to handle a variety of tasks, including text generation, coding, analysis, and more. With its multi-agent architecture, Grok 4.20 is capable of processing complex inputs and producing structured outputs, making it a versatile tool for developers.

### Technical Specifications and Pricing
From a technical standpoint, xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent boasts a context window of 2,000,000 tokens and can generate outputs of up to 4,096 tokens. The model's knowledge cutoff is 2023-12, ensuring it has a broad and up-to-date understanding of the world. In terms of pricing, the model costs $2.0 per 1M input tokens and $6.0 per 1M output tokens. For example, 1,000 calls with an average of 500 tokens would cost $4.0, while 10,000 calls would cost $40.0, and 100,000 calls would cost $400.0. The model's capabilities include text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs, making it suitable for chat, text generation, coding, analysis, RAG pipelines, and summarization tasks.

### Performance and Use Cases
The xAI: Grok 4.20 Multi-Agent model has demonstrated its strength through various benchmarks, achieving an MMLU score of 80.0 and an LMSYS Arena ELO score of 1200. While it does not have direct competitors, its unique combination of capabilities and pricing make it an attractive option for developers looking to integrate AI into their applications.
